content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and similar platforms promise seamless course creation and sales, but they come with significant limitations for creators in restricted countries. Stripe integration is common, but if you're outside its service area, you're effectively barred from those tools. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack allow you to build a fully operational online store with complete ownership of your data and products. You can accept payments in cryptocurrencies without relying on traditional banks or payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Teachable and Stripe impose geographical restrictions that leave many creators in emerging markets without viable options. PayPal's policies can also be detrimental, as account suspensions may freeze funds for up to 180 days with no recourse. In contrast, sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to bypass these barriers entirely. With platforms like NOWPayments integrated into COREMERCH's offerings, you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies without the risk of suspension or geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms often impose high fees and long payment processing times. For instance, Stripe may take days to clear funds, and PayPal has been known for delayed disbursements. On the other hand, sovereign commerce solutions offer real-time payment processing through crypto, with fees as low as 0.5%. This means your income reaches you almost instantly, allowing for greater cash flow management. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll have low transaction costs on networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON, ensuring your profits are maximized.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure guarantees full ownership of your data and products.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With platforms like Teachable, you're at the mercy of their terms and conditions, meaning they retain control over your data and sales. In contrast, COREMERCH's infrastructure provides true ownership. Once deployed, you have complete control over your online store, customer data, and product delivery. Automated systems ensure that payments are verified on-chain, and digital products are delivered instantly, all without intermediary control. This level of sovereignty is crucial for creators wanting to maintain their business integrity.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Choosing the right architecture hinges on your specific needs. If you're a creator in a restricted country, consider the Edge Commerce Stack. It’s deployed in 48 hours, includes full payment processing capabilities, and offers extensive support. Alternatively, for those looking for a more DIY approach, the Sovereign Blueprint provides comprehensive documentation to help you set up your own stack. Ultimately, the goal is to ensure that you have a robust system that is resilient against traditional payment barriers.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Say goodbye to payment suspensions and hello to instant crypto payments.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
